correctness.rationale: The ten-word witness passes the definition directly. A fresh complete enumeration found no bad 2- or 3-subsets, exactly 891 minimal bad 4-subsets, and verified that every bad 5-subset contains a bad 4-subset. Independent coordinatewise symbol permutations normalize any hypothetical 11-word code to contain 000; exact branch-and-bound avoiding the 891 obstructions found no such code. Thus the maximum is 10. The only source-file defects are two literal C0/control escape corruptions in RESULT.md: a tab before 'imes' where '\\times' is intended and a form-feed before 'rac' where '\\frac' is intended; they do not alter the mathematical argument when repaired.
